title: Claims Dashboard | Dispute Flow | Customer Disagrees with NE Decision | Dispute Case Created
goal: Customer receives Not Eligible result, disagrees, and initiates a dispute through the chatbot. System must create a dispute record linked to the original case and route to manual review team.

checkpoints.step: Customer receives Not Eligible result, disagrees, and initiates a dispute through the chatbot. System must create a dispute record linked to the original case and route to manual review team.
Original case exists: CASE-FD-20260520-050 (Not Eligible, NE-01 uncontrollable � weather); Customer returns to chatbot to dispute
checkpoints.expected: Original case exists: CASE-FD-20260520-050 (Not Eligible, NE-01 uncontrollable � weather); Customer returns to chatbot to dispute

checkpoints.step: Given the user opens the agentic chatbot
Then the chatbot displays greeting (GLOB-01):
checkpoints.expected: Hello! I will be your virtual assistant today. I can assist you in English or French. Which language would you prefer to use today?

checkpoints.step: Then user selects English

Then an alert information is displayed "Please note that by using this service, you will interact with an automated chatbot which uses AI to answer your questions and requests. Your personal information will be used to identify and authenticate you, to answer your request, and for other purposes detailed in the Privacy Notice."
checkpoints.expected: Please note that by using this service, you will interact with an automated chatbot which uses AI to answer your questions and requests. Your personal information will be used to identify and authenticate you, to answer your request, and for other purposes detailed in the Privacy Notice.

checkpoints.step: Then chatbot asks "How can I help you today?"
checkpoints.expected: How can I help you today?

checkpoints.step: And the user says "I received a decision that I'm not eligible for compensation for my delayed flight but I disagree. The weather was fine when I was at the airport. I want to dispute this decision."
checkpoints.expected: I received a decision that I'm not eligible for compensation for my delayed flight but I disagree. The weather was fine when I was at the airport. I want to dispute this decision.

checkpoints.step: When the chatbot identifies dispute intent
Then the chatbot responds:
checkpoints.expected: I understand you'd like to dispute a previous decision on your flight disruption claim. I can help you with that. Let me look up your case.

checkpoints.step: Then the chatbot responds:
checkpoints.expected: To find your case, could you please provide your booking reference number (PNR) or case reference number?

checkpoints.step: And the user provides "My case reference is CASE-FD-20260520-050"
checkpoints.expected: My case reference is CASE-FD-20260520-050

checkpoints.step: Then the system searches Case Services for: CASE-FD-20260520-050
And Case Services returns: CASE FOUND
